evidence: Conditional engineering quantities and future U budgets for four assumed usable cave settings and 100 towns. No site approval, qualified pressure structure, complete menu, ecological validation or supplier quotation.
rules: Four 50,000-person cities plus 100 towns of 500 people form the 250,000-person reference. Food and everyday industry serve all residents; city ordinary housing serves only the added 200,000.

This conditional costing proceeds without selecting four sites. It assumes existing usable caverns with dry, flood-safe floors and access throughout the planned water and atmosphere transition. Major waterproofing or undersea access would require a separate variant. The natural cavern remains unpressurized during vacuum operation; independent closed pressure halls take pressure loads. This is a costing architecture, not an adopted city layout.

The town baseline is preserved. Credit its entire dedicated power, storage and radiator capital and operating rows before replacing them with one integrated utility account. Credit an assumed 25% ordinary-capital production allocation and associated extra freight before adding common food and light-industry facilities. The original ordinary capital was not itemized; a no-production-credit sensitivity is required.

The food capacity basket is a vacuum engineering case: cultivated plant calories, recirculating fish and processed microbial protein. It preserves the inherited 2500 kcal reference and includes crop losses, variety, all fish feed, spare production and stored food. It does not replace the adopted mature Open Moon blend, establish a complete menu or price optional heritage-animal husbandry.
All new prices, installation masses, recovery rates and operating staff counts are scenario assumptions. Material and food precedents constrain requirements; they do not measure future U prices.

Installed facility prices include their normal hardware and delivery. Dedicated electricity supply and exterior cooling are charged separately. Imported ordinary building equipment incurs only the inherited extra vacuum freight increment. Supplier mine/factory/fleet capital embedded in installed prices is not added again.

Everyday goods production excludes replacement of the accounted durable assets; those replacements are bought through their installed renewal prices. Routine technical upkeep excludes production operators and civic-service staffing, which are separately charged.

Annual funding equals routine physical upkeep, operating supplies and service labour, operating margin and component renewal reserve. Horizon cash adds actual replacement events instead of the annual reserve again. Initial contingency and eventual enclosure-removal funding are not repeated every year.

The long-term inventory assumes source protection, reserved future feedstock and retained tails. Ordinary lunar rock supplies bulk and selected metals; imported volatiles, carbon, nutrients and specialist equipment use permitted Solar System and Earth supply. No polar-ice extraction, unapproved heritage disturbance or zero-impact quarry is assumed.

The third study will replace purchased supply allowances with mining, manufacturing and Earth/near-Earth procurement engineering. U remains unconverted. Financing, migration fares and discretionary luxury consumption are outside the physical settlement and basic-service account.

Moon-wide lava-tube distribution and a 2.5% buildout count are future work. The inventory must distinguish tube systems, accessible segments and entrances before defining the denominator; the crater catalogue is not a lava-tube count.

Stored food is produced by the commissioned local farms before full occupation. Its initial working inventory uses variable production/packing charges and explicit electricity. Rotation feeds ordinary meals; ongoing losses are already in the crop allowance and do not create a second annual replacement charge.

The goods-processing variable charge covers process consumables and bought services beyond separately counted feedstock, electricity, production staff and durable-asset upkeep. Specialist consumables exclude component replacements funded in the renewal account. Carbon-bearing everyday material feed is imported separately from local mineral feed.

Firm power retains the adopted beamed supply programme, with required lunar-night continuity. The 72-hour critical reserve does not operate full crop lighting. Solar-only month-scale storage is a diagnostic, not included in the reference.

Access and transport material allowances are included in their installed prices. Regional startup includes the added construction-plant hardware. Construction-worker provisions and supplier consumables are embedded in supplier charges; the physical mass ledger describes commissioned stock and major process feed, not every construction logistics shipment.

New ordinary-capital replacement prices include normal delivered hardware; only ordinary building equipment receives the inherited additional vacuum freight charge. Local structural renewal conversion electricity is a purchased supplier service, distinct from continuously occupied electricity.

The physical annual import account includes water, air, biosphere, nutrient and carbon makeup, specialist consumables and amortized replacement hardware. Lifetimes describe expected replacement of installed components; they do not establish lunar service life.

Working carbon and nutrient stocks are imported before farms fill the food reserve. Food carbon uses a CO2-like feed with 27% carbon by mass; NPK salts use 2.5 times elemental mass as a delivery allowance. These material balances do not establish a complete nutrient formulation. Initial food production charges exclude those separately billed stocks and electricity.
